manage_profiles_tiers_hazard: ⚠ Tiers are positional — adding or removing the last tier is safe; reordering or removing a middle tier will silently rebind agents.
manage_profiles_apply_desc: This will push the current profile registry to all live agents. Each agent rebuilds its failover state on its next wake-up.
manage_profiles_endpoint_dialog_desc: Configure an LLM endpoint: family, base URL, and API key.
manage_profiles_endpoint_id_hint: Locked while editing — renaming would dangle every profile referencing it.
manage_profiles_endpoint_id_duplicate: This ID is already in use.
manage_profiles_endpoint_base_url_hint: Required for openai-compatible (e.g. https://host/v1); other families default to their official URL when empty.
manage_profiles_endpoint_api_key_require: A key is required for a new endpoint.
manage_profiles_endpoint_api_key_hint_ed: Current: {mask}. Leave empty to keep, or type to replace.
manage_profiles_tier_dialog_desc: Configure this tier's failover profile list: order is priority, the first is active.
manage_profiles_tier_dialog_no_endpoints: No endpoints defined yet — add one in the endpoints section first.
manage_profiles_tier_drop_here: Drop to move into this tier
manage_profiles_heading_desc: Three layers: endpoints form a global pool; tier containers hold draggable profile cards. Endpoint Test = connectivity; profile Test = one minimal real inference.
manage_profiles_profile_test_aria: Run one minimal real inference test on this profile
